definitions.gloss: earplugs; small soft inserts worn in the ear canal to block out noise or keep water out of the ears
definitions.explanation: The everyday Japanese word for earplugs of any kind: the foam, silicone, or wax inserts used to reduce noise while sleeping, studying, or working in loud environments, as well as the rubber or silicone plugs used by swimmers to keep water out of their ears. Like its English counterpart, {耳栓|みみせん} is generally used as a plural concept, even though Japanese makes no plural distinction. They are sold inexpensively in pharmacies, convenience stores, and 100-yen shops.

examples.japanese: {耳栓|みみせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
{試験中|しけんちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{耳栓|みみせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}している→集中する：21908_shuuchuusuru⟧。
examples.english: I use earplugs to concentrate during exams.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うるさい→うるさい：00763_urusai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{耳栓|みみせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧きた。
examples.english: The next room is so noisy that I went out and bought earplugs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れない→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{耳栓|みみせん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧アイマスク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦おすすめ→おすすめ：09746_osusume⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: For people who can't sleep on planes, I recommend taking earplugs and an eye mask with you.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧ ('ear') + ⟦{栓|せん}→栓：19366_sen⟧ ('plug, stopper'). The compound is straightforward and the meaning matches the parts: literally an 'ear plug'.

USAGE:
Almost always used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ or other verbs of wearing, removing, or buying. The plural/singular distinction does not exist in Japanese, so {耳栓|みみせん} can refer to a single plug or a pair depending on context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耳栓|みみせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to put in earplugs
- {耳栓|みみせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to put on earplugs
- {耳栓|みみせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧: same; written form
- {耳栓|みみせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to take out earplugs
- {耳栓|みみせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧はめる: to insert earplugs
- {耳栓|みみせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use earplugs
- {耳栓|みみせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy earplugs
- ⟦{防音|ぼうおん}→防音：14565_bouon⟧{耳栓|みみせん}: noise-blocking earplugs
- {睡眠用|すいみんよう}{耳栓|みみせん}: earplugs for sleeping
- {水泳用|すいえいよう}{耳栓|みみせん}: swimming earplugs
- ⟦シリコン→シリコン：29883_shirikon⟧{耳栓|みみせん}: silicone earplugs
- ⟦スポンジ→スポンジ：04505_suponji⟧{耳栓|みみせん}: foam earplugs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- イヤー⟦プラグ→プラグ：07807_puragu⟧: earplugs — the English loanword; used mainly in product names and audio-equipment contexts. Less common than {耳栓|みみせん} in everyday speech.
- イヤーマフ: earmuffs — the over-the-ear hearing-protection variety; covers the whole ear rather than going inside the canal.
- ⟦{栓|せん}→栓：19366_sen⟧: plug, stopper — the general word for a plug used to seal an opening (a bottle stopper, drain plug, etc.).

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese cities, earplugs are popular among students preparing for entrance exams (⟦{受験生|じゅけんせい}→受験生：18622_jukensei⟧), light sleepers in shared housing, and travelers facing long bullet-train or international flights. They are sold cheaply at convenience stores, pharmacies, and 100-yen shops, and many brands advertise specific noise-reduction ratings (NRR) on the packaging.
